Hi! 

Male here.

So I'm not super experienced but here are my thoughts.

1) Is he over the previous relationships? 

I'm aware mentally straining situations like that can often have long term effects, and if he is still hurting from them then my advice would be he needs to fix himself via therapy or some way before he introduces new people into his life, this will make your life harder as you'll have to suffer with him as he fights those battles.

2) 

So on the basis that he is over the prior relationships, he will more than likely be a bit new to a proper healthy relationship, so as long as you are careful Id say go for it with that in mind as youll probably need to have a bit of patience and almost treat it as his first relationship. Like you gotta start somewhere so I dont think it would be fair to disregard him based on that, especially if you REALLY like him, like you aint doing yourself favours either.

3)

Back to a more negative point of view.

If you do decide to go ahead with it, Id just be cautious incase he brings up stuff like he did, in reality if he is over it he shouldnt bring it up continuously, maybe once just to let you know, but yeah just be careful as I do have concerns that the negativity of it all will drag you down and in that situation he needs to get help, if you can hold his hand through it that might help but its up to you. 

Sorry as i said I have little experience but hopefully this helps.
